content: Training on BioAsq data in our entry in Batch 1 and Batch 2 under the name QA1 showed it might lead to overfitting. This happened both with (Batch 2) and without (Batch 1) hyperparameters tuning: abysmal 18% MRR in Batch 1, and slighly better one, 40% in Batch 2 (although in Batch 2 it was overall the second best result in MRR but 16% lower than the highest score).
